O.outcome_detail: Correct response to a converging-lens conceptual question

cells.quote: Lastly, the students were asked a question on their ﬁnal exam that tested their knowledge of converging lenses, “When you block the left hal f of the object, what image should you see on the other side of a converging lens?” T his was one of the harder, more conceptual questions on the exam. Even so, 58% o f the students got the correct answer, which was close to the average of the lab ﬁnal.
cells.note: The study states that students had no content knowledge prior to the lab and describes the activity as an introduction to inquiry, supporting novice expertise. It reports 58% correct and says this was close to the average of the lab final, but gives no comparison value, effect size, significance test, or stated experimental design.
